method: stratified random sample; strata = statement type x consequence rank; every stratum gets min(2, its size), the rest is split in proportion to stratum size (largest remainder); within a stratum, random.Random('1029:<stratum>').sample over statements sorted by id. Small strata are over-sampled on purpose: use each stratum's weight (population / sampled) for a plant-wide estimate.
